description: Telescope Partners | Software Engineer & Data Scientist | On-site US, San Francisco | Full-time Telescope is an early stage growth VC firm with a focus on enterprise software companies. We're a small, efficient team, with a beautiful office in Presidio. We work closely with entrepreneurs and help them fill critical business functions as they grow. Our tech team is mostly oriented at team efficiency and improving investment decision-making using data. This involves replacing as much investor work and intelligence with automation as possible. If you're interested in PE, agents, and data science, then this might be a good role for you! We’re looking for someone with 3-10 years of experience. To apply email mike at telescopepartners.com
